definitions: A fictional character, often depicted as a hero or a being of light, in various fantasy stories, video games, and other media.
A name sometimes used for a star, planet, or other celestial body in fictional universes, implying brightness or illumination.
A brand name for certain lighting products or technologies, emphasizing their luminous qualities.
examples: Lumios wielded the Sword of Dawn.
The explorers set course for Lumios, the shining planet.
We installed Lumios LED strips in the kitchen.
